title_en: In the Courtroom (12/20): The Factory Pollution Case
note_en: Watch the multiplier in 比厂长当初舍不得花的治污设备还要多出一倍: 多出一倍 means "one hundred percent more," i.e. twice as much, not "one time more." 比 introduces what is being compared, and 还要 adds "even" for emphasis. Chinese 倍 counts the difference when it follows 多出 or 增加了, but the total when it follows 是 (是…的两倍 "twice as much as"), so the two patterns describe the same amount.
